title: ERC-8004 actors and trust boundaries
caption: Five trust zones. The owner controls the token, the file and the wallet binding; clients write feedback; the chain holds three registries, one of them only specified; off-chain hosts serve files the chain never reads; indexers turn events into rankings. Payment happens elsewhere.
alt: Flowchart. The owner zone holds the agent owner, operators and the agent wallet. The owner registers and updates the agent in the Identity Registry and binds the wallet with a signature. The off-chain zone holds the registration file host, the .well-known domain proof and feedback files. The client zone holds clients and responders, which call giveFeedback and appendResponse on the Reputation Registry. The Validation Registry is drawn dashed as specified, not officially deployed, with a validator. The registry owner, one externally owned account, can upgrade all registries. Indexers and explorers read events and files. A payment rail such as x402 sits outside ERC-8004.
